Hi Noor,

Thanks for applying to the Software Engineer, Inference position — really enjoyed your profile. Would love to set up a 25–30 minute phone screen with our hiring manager to go over your background and a quick technical fit check.

Available windows this week (all times in candidate local time — if one works say which you prefer and I’ll send an invite):
- Wed 21 Apr: 09:00–11:00 CEST (we can do a 30m slot starting 09:30)
- Wed 21 Apr: 16:00–18:00 CEST (if you prefer afternoon)
- Thu 22 Apr: 07:30–10:00 CEST (early-morning option)

If none of the above fit, tell me two 30-minute blocks that do and I’ll coordinate. If easier, here’s my scheduling link: calendly.com/stephanie-ng/30m (or I can send an ICS). Role one-pager attached for context.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
